author: RamSet
releaseNotes: 0.19.0 - Stops the log filling up with 'HAP: no update in Ns — reconnecting to reconcile' on an idle thermostat. When the HVAC is off and the temperature is steady, the ecobee sends no HomeKit updates for a few minutes; that tripped a fixed 2-minute 'is the session still alive?' timer and forced a reconnect over and over. There's now a configurable window (new 'Live-session safety-reconnect window' preference, default 6 minutes — above the background refresh) so a quiet, healthy thermostat stays connected instead of reconnecting on a loop, and that message is now an info note rather than a warning (hapCore 0.10.3). Nothing was malfunctioning before — it was noisy, not broken. After updating, open the thermostat device once and click Save Preferences for the new window to take effect.
